name: Clearing Broker Identification 1
definition: Specifies the reference number assigned by the clearing broker. A distinction can be made between the reference for the Central Counterparty (CCP) leg and the reference for the client leg of the transaction.

SideIndicator.name: Side Indicator
SideIndicator.definition: Distinguishes the client leg from the central counterparty (CCP) leg in the clearing broker identification.

ClearingBrokerIdentification.name: Clearing Broker Identification
ClearingBrokerIdentification.definition: Specifies the identification assigned to the clearing broker.
